annotations.title: Get the price to renew an LEI without signing in

description: Returns what it costs to renew one LEI that Global FinReg manages, for a user who isn't signed in: the legal name, expiry date, the total for 1, 3 and 5 years (net amount, VAT, currency) and the payment methods. Pass the LEI number, or the renewal link from the user's Global FinReg reminder email. With only the LEI number the renewal can be paid by card; with the renewal link also by invoice. status is open (can be ordered), paid, invoice_ordered or unavailable (reason and nextStep say why). For an LEI another provider manages, or a user who wants to see their account, use the account tools instead. Always show the user the price and get their agreement before calling order_lei_renewal.

lei.description: The 20-character LEI to renew, e.g. 894500AAX24OVFGAR954. Leave it out when you pass renewalLink.

renewalLink.description: Optional: the renewal link from Global FinReg's renewal reminder email, exactly as the user gives it (https://.../lei/renewal-link?lei=...&t=...). With it the renewal can also be paid by invoice.
